classification: uncalibrated reference simulation and synthetic numerical fixtures; not TARS or Phoenix acceptance

hardware.provenance: RF/VMEM capacity and scalar EXT/VPU rates anchored to R5 Hardware; new explicitly simplified single-server EXT/local ports with command-level visibility; FP32 and BF16-unpack capabilities independently assumed, no claim of R5 request/credit-model reproduction. No R9 parameter import.
hardware.resource_semantics: one nonpreemptive command per EXT or local port; compute server per core; background pauses payload service on EXT/local only. A command's descriptor+setup is also charged service. No unbounded issued commands or return buffers: capacity is one serving command per port; queued commands own only declared ping-pong slots. Transfer visible at completion. Existing RF allocation may survive only within a recurrence phase.

numeric.external_dense_weight_dtype: BF16 lossless encoding of generated BF16-representable values
numeric.permission: Source-semantic FP32 research execution, FP32 intermediate projections/conv/norm. BF16 packed weights expanded exactly to FP32; 1 VPU op per converted element is charged. No source dtype-bitwise/official optimized chunk-kernel equivalence or trained-checkpoint claim.

lifecycle.prefill: four hidden input vectors of a known continuation block available in EXT at module entry; prior conv/recurrent cache in EXT. Full dense input projection and causal conv/gates/norm paid before prepared vectors are consumed. Store prepared FP32 vectors and z in shared VMEM, process state head waves. All per-token module outputs and final state/conv cache returned EXT.
lifecycle.decode: only one hidden vector available per invocation; next vector release depends on previous final EXT output and state visibility plus caller boundary that clobbers RF/VMEM. No timed other-layer interval is invented. Four invocations are work accounting only; no tokens/s claim.
lifecycle.weights: all dense weights cold in EXT each module invocation, streamed through identical two-slot VMEM/RF buffers; prefill uses four rows per loaded weight tile, decode one. Other model weights excluded, no persistent weight cache assumed.

background.phase: independent seeded uniform integer on [0,4096) per port, paired between variants

gate.conditions: quiet >=5; each background group mean>=5 and CI lower>0; all audits pass
